title: Decision
description: The gate's verdict for an intercepted Action. Produced by combining the deterministic extractor output, the JEV response, and the policy engine threshold evaluation.

action_id.description: The ID of the Action this decision corresponds to.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the decision was issued.

verdict.description: The gate's final verdict. 'pending' is set when JEV is unreachable (do-nothing policy). 'ask' enqueues the action for human approval.

policy_reasons.description: Ordered list of reasons produced by the policy engine that drove the verdict. Each reason maps to a JEV answer or a deterministic rule.

cost_usd.description: Estimated USD cost of the JEV call for this decision.

ttl_expires_at.description: For 'pending' verdicts only. If JEV does not respond before this timestamp, the action is permanently denied.

source.description: Whether this reason was produced by the deterministic extractor or by JEV.

severity.description: Impact of this reason on the verdict. 'block' alone can trigger deny.

probability.description: JEV calibrated probability for this reason. Only present when source = 'jev'.

JEVResponse.description: The raw, structured response from the JEV API, stored as-is for auditability.

call_id.description: Unique identifier returned by the JEV API for this call.

raw_answers.description: Full answer map as returned by JEV. Keys are question names; values are typed answer objects.

error.description: Populated only when JEV returned an error or timed out.

JEVAnswer.description: A single answer from JEV. For choice questions, 'probabilities' contains the full distribution.

value.description: The selected value. Boolean for boolean questions, string for choice, number for score.

probability.description: Calibrated confidence of the selected value.

probabilities.description: Full probability distribution over all options. Only present for choice questions.

LatencyBreakdown.description: End-to-end latency breakdown for observability and p50/p95 tracking.

total_ms.description: Total gate latency from intercept to verdict.

extractor_ms.description: Time spent in the deterministic extractor.

jev_ms.description: Round-trip time to the JEV API.

policy_ms.description: Time spent in the policy engine.

HumanApproval.description: Only populated for 'ask' verdicts after a human has acted on the queue.

approver_id.description: ID of the human who acted on the approval queue.

approved.description: True if the human approved the action, false if they rejected it.
